children: Germany's regulator said on Monday that DHL's Deutsche Post
may increase letter prices, given a sharp decline in the volume of letters, and offered its proposal for postage rate increases.
Deutsche Post may increase letter prices by 20.35% and prices for private customer parcels by 10.72%, the Federal Network Agency said.
The agency said it has remained below Deutsche Post's requested adjustments and has not taken into account rising value-added and overhead costs claimed by the company.
It said the new rates are intended to apply in the years 2027 and 2028.
Deutsche Post, competitors, consumer protection organisations and other interested parties may submit comments on the proposed decision by October 30.
The final decision is expected to be published in November.
